data.content_ref: inline:The relation is labelled 'abstracts,' yet the refuting condition ('shared primitive failure probability exceeds shared runtime failure probability') does not test the abstraction's validity at all — it tests a comparative risk magnitude. An abstraction of risk can remain coherent even when the abstracted risk dominates; the proposed refutation would only bear on whether the abstraction is empirically dominant, not on whether the relation 'abstracts' is genuine.
